description: Small expected-refusal corpus gate. These rows must fail with specific diagnostics; this catches correct refusals becoming silent acceptances.

scripts.expectedDiagnosticIncludes: TA length must be a positive integer
scripts.gateSelectionReason: Invalid TA length sentinel; this class moved 43 corpus rows when silent length coercion became a correct refusal.

scripts.expectedDiagnosticIncludes: iff() was removed in Pine v5
scripts.gateSelectionReason: Modern Pine v5 must refuse the removed legacy iff() helper.

scripts.expectedDiagnosticIncludes: iff() was removed in Pine v5
scripts.gateSelectionReason: Modern Pine v6 must refuse the removed legacy iff() helper.

scripts.expectedDiagnosticIncludes: request.security lookahead must be a compile-time barmerge value
scripts.gateSelectionReason: Runtime-computed request.security barmerge mode must stay refused.

scripts.expectedDiagnosticIncludes: plot linewidth must be at least 1 in Pine v6
scripts.gateSelectionReason: Pine v6 migration sentinel: linewidth=0 was valid in v3-v5 and must stay refused under declared v6.

scripts.expectedDiagnosticIncludes: Index 'from' should be less than index 'to'
scripts.gateSelectionReason: array.slice descending range must stay a Pine runtime refusal.
